subject: [PATCH] ipmi:msghandler: Free queued requests of a destroyed user

reviews.author: Corey Minyard

2026-11-21.patch_summary: This patch addresses a memory leak issue in the IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) driver, where requests from destroyed users are not properly freed when the BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) stops responding to IPMI requests. The patch introduces a new function to free queued requests of a destroyed user, preventing the accumulation of closed users and their messages, which can consume significant memory over time. This issue was identified in Meta's fleet, where hosts with malfunctioning BMCs accumulated millions of closed users, leading to memory usage issues. The patch has been tested on QEMU with a fake BMC that stops answering IPMI requests and shows significant reductions in the number of held closed users.
